common_contract.completion: TransferSession::run serializes the session and synchronizes before returning
common_contract.precision: The launcher preserves caller element types. Physical callers must retain frozen f32 paths.
common_contract.migration_rule: Replace the private method only after KernelAbi describes every slot and caller span proof.

launcher_checks: all four buffers use one session
methods.access_span: Opaque at this boundary. Each caller proves metadata, parameters, state and output spans.
methods.metadata_proof: Caller-specific safety comments and constructor checks remain authoritative.
methods.legal_input_domain: A nonzero one-dimensional work count with a caller-proven eight-slot ABI.

methods.access_span: Exact guarded rhs, output and factor capacities are checked.
methods.metadata_proof: Packed route, diagonal, level and Small descriptors come from MixedSolvePlan.
methods.legal_input_domain: Disjoint Small blocks and Sparse-only updates; one block owns one world/RHS.

methods.access_span: Each thread owns one guarded dense prefix block.
methods.metadata_proof: Static size 2..6 triples store DOF start, prefix address and size.
methods.legal_input_domain: Disjoint static blocks with worlds*count work items.

methods.access_span: Exact guarded rhs, output and sparse factor capacities are checked.
methods.metadata_proof: Validated sparse row and level metadata bounds every block barrier phase.
methods.legal_input_domain: One 128-thread block owns one world/RHS and every lane reaches each barrier.

launcher_checks: all six buffers use one session
methods.access_span: Caller proves guarded strides nv, nv, 14*nbody+6*nv, 6*nbody+6*nv and 12*nbody+nv.
methods.metadata_proof: Validated parent and DOF maps bound every index; bool becomes private u32.
methods.legal_input_domain: Finite guarded resident RNE inputs for one model identity.

launcher_checks: all five buffers use one session
methods.access_span: Caller proves model, velocity, status and 2*worlds*nv guarded output spans.
methods.metadata_proof: The first kernel validates guards, mapping and finite inputs before clear and accumulation.
methods.legal_input_domain: Matching model identity, world count, nv, tendon count and maximum sparse row.

launcher_checks: all five buffers use one session
methods.access_span: Caller proves rigid, COM, partial-force, gravity and final force spans.
methods.metadata_proof: Validation status precedes body/DOF work; checked nb, nv and worlds derive every count.
methods.legal_input_domain: Active gravity-compensation spec with matching resident rigid and COM tickets.

launcher_checks: all seven buffers use one session
methods.access_span: Caller proves parameters, rigid, COM, velocity, optional attached, body-force, qfrc and status spans.
methods.metadata_proof: A validation launch checks guards, mappings and finite values before body force and DOF projection.
methods.legal_input_domain: Matching resident velocity inputs; optional attached data falls back to the parameter buffer only where the ABI ignores it.

launcher_checks: all six buffers use one session
methods.access_span: Caller proves element, edge-pair, node-offset, 21-value and output ranges.
methods.metadata_proof: Resident model conversion validates topology; a following validation kernel checks publication.
methods.legal_input_domain: Linear flex elements using the existing 21-coefficient product path.

launcher_checks: all five buffers use one session
methods.access_span: Flex callers prove endpoints, CSR rows and ancestry. RNE bias proves spatial strides and parent/DOF maps.
methods.metadata_proof: The method name is semantic, but the ABI is reused by RNE bias. Migration must key by ABI contract.
methods.legal_input_domain: Either checked flex-edge data or the separately proven compatible RNE-bias five-pointer ABI.

methods.access_span: Exact guarded pair, current and staged capacities are checked.
methods.metadata_proof: The caller proves static nv equals metadata and the compiled kernel; every warp lane reaches ballot.
methods.legal_input_domain: One warp per world, n at most 1024, finite validated pairs, disjoint staged publication.

findings.finding: The generic launch method performs no capacity validation beyond nonempty allocations.
findings.required_action: M3 must encode all 85 caller spans before replacing any call.

findings.finding: launch_flex_edges serves both flex edges and RNE bias.
findings.required_action: Use separate typed KernelAbi descriptors despite the shared low-level signature.

findings.finding: Seven specialized methods still rely on caller-only topology and span proofs.
findings.required_action: Safe wrappers must move those proofs into checked views or explicit span descriptors.

findings.finding: Mixed solve, small factor, sparse solve and kinetic energy already enforce exact capacities.
findings.required_action: M3 must preserve their formulas and thread geometry exactly.

findings.finding: Every current method synchronizes before returning.
findings.required_action: M3 launch_sync must preserve this completion boundary before later asynchronous phases.
